title: Loop configuration (defaults < workspace config.json < CLI flags)

max_trials.description: How many trials a milestone gets before the run stops, and how many tries the plan step gets. A trial is one attempt to build the milestone and pass its validation.

max_invocations_per_run.description: The most calls to Claude Code one run may make. When a run reaches it, the run stops (invocation-cap).

invocation_timeout_seconds.description: How long one call to Claude Code may run, in seconds. A call that takes longer is stopped and its trial fails (timeout).

max_budget_usd_per_invocation.description: The most one call to Claude Code may spend, in US dollars, passed to Claude Code as its budget. null sets no limit.

model.description: The model every step uses unless `models` names one for that step, passed to Claude Code as --model. null lets Claude Code choose its default.

models.description: A model per step, for example a strong model to plan and a cheaper one to write code. A step not named here, or set to null, uses `model`.

plan.description: The model of the plan step, which turns the requirements into milestones.

replan.description: The model of the replan step, which revises a plan after the developer's feedback.

author-checks.description: The model of the author-checks step, which writes a backend milestone's HTTP checks before any code.

implement.description: The model of the implement step, a milestone's first trial.

fix.description: The model of the fix step, each later trial of a milestone.

fix_last_trial.description: The model of a milestone's last allowed fix trial, so a hard failure gets a stronger attempt before the run stops.

validate-ui.description: The model of the validate-ui step, which checks a frontend milestone in a real browser.

implement_tools.description: The Claude Code tools the implement and fix steps may use. They are the only steps that change code.

unit_tests.description: Running the target's unit tests as part of validation.

enabled.description: Run unit tests when a milestone is validated; a failing test fails the trial.

command.description: The command that runs the unit tests. null uses the command the plan names (runtime.unit_test_command).

runtime.description: How to start the application while it is validated. Each key set here replaces the value the plan chose.

install_command.description: How to install the application's dependencies. Shown with the plan; devloops does not run it (the implement step installs dependencies).

start_command.description: The command that starts the application for validation.

cwd.description: The folder the start command runs in, relative to the target.

base_url.description: The address the running application answers on, for example http://127.0.0.1:8000.

ready_url.description: An address devloops asks until it answers, to know the application has started.

ready_timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for the application to answer at its ready address, in seconds, before the trial fails.

openapi_path.description: Where the backend writes its OpenAPI document, relative to the target.

backend.description: For the frontend loop only: the backend its pages call while they are validated.

base_url.description: The address of the backend. Without a start command, devloops expects a backend already running there.

start_command.description: The command that starts the backend during frontend validation.

cwd.description: The folder the backend's start command runs in, relative to the frontend target.

ready_url.description: An address devloops asks until it answers, to know the backend has started. Defaults to backend.base_url.

playwright.description: The browser the frontend loop validates in, driven through the Playwright MCP server.

headless.description: true runs the browser without a window. false shows it, so you can watch validation; that needs a display.

executable_path.description: The browser program to start, when the Chrome that Playwright expects is not installed. Used only when mcp_command is null.

mcp_command.description: The full command that starts the Playwright MCP server, used exactly as written. null runs npx @playwright/mcp@latest with the two settings above.

git.description: Git commits devloops makes in the target.

commit_per_milestone.description: After each achieved milestone, commit the target's changes. A failed commit does not fail the milestone.

secrets.description: Values devloops replaces with *** before it writes anything: prompts, call records, logs, evidence and reports.

env.description: Names of environment variables whose values are secret.

boundary.description: Where Claude Code may write. Writes outside the target fail the trial.

allowed_extra.description: Extra paths Claude Code may write to inside a checked git repository, for example a cache folder.

questions.description: What happens to the plan and to open questions. accept-suggested: the plan is approved and Claude's suggested answers are accepted without pausing, and flagged for review; a question without a suggestion still stops the run. ask: every plan pauses for your review, and open questions stop the run.
